measurement_rule: Measure only the authorized source musical content bound to the proposed KK. Exclude delivery padding, silence added for delivery, and Twinkle/bookends.
structural_rule: Duration never establishes BLK identity. A normal structurally proven KK below 10.000 seconds is blocked unless an exact locked exception applies.

existing_law_reconciliation.existing_statement: Duration is not a KK qualification rule.
existing_law_reconciliation.proposed_reconciliation: Structure and meaning qualify the BLK/KK; the 10-second control is a release anomaly gate with exact one-off exceptions, not a slicing rule or structural definition.

exceptions.use_rule: Not exercisable until exact LT-PIX identity, source hash, structural proof, owner approval, and minimum duration are locked. Title matching is forbidden.
